question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of renewable materials out of the total product mass in relation to renewable materials?
data_point: mass fraction of renewable materials out of the total product mass
description: The mass fraction of renewable materials out of the total product mass is a measure of the proportion of renewable materials used in the production of a product, expressed as a percentage of the total product mass. This metric is used to assess the sustainability of a product by evaluating the amount of renewable materials incorporated into its composition.
